emails.purpose: independent music submissions for Wepa.Fm airplay consideration
emails.verificationNote: The address is published in plaintext on Wepa.Fm's first-party independent-music submission page and is explicitly designated for music submissions. Syntax and domain/context alignment were verified; no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

adjacentEmailsExcluded.reasonExcluded: The staff page identifies this as the program/music director address, but the dedicated submission page directs artists to info@wepa.fm. It is retained only as adjacent staff evidence.

businessContact.emailStatus: One first-party-published, domain-aligned and purpose-aligned submission mailbox was retained. The program/music director address was excluded from the submission route because the dedicated page publishes a different canonical mailbox.
businessContact.verification: Email verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax and purpose/domain/context alignment. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.captchaStatus: not applicable to the published editorial email route
formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: A signed external legal agreement, rights verification, final track and format review, attachment preparation and human-controlled email are required.

activityVerification.evidence: Wepa.Fm's current site exposes live-radio/now-playing surfaces, a current staff roster, 2026 artist spotlights and the 2026 Calle Ocho Freestyle/Latin Music Stage. The dedicated submission page is publicly accessible and currently states the submission requirements.

genreFitEvidence: Wepa.Fm publishes a bilingual format spanning disco, salsa, freestyle, merengue, bachata, house, reggaeton, classics and pop.
The station states that it supports independent labels, publishers and artists and broadcasts worldwide.
Carnival or Curaçao may have the closest MarcsMusic fit, but the final clean master and exact station-format fit require human selection.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The first-party route is active and free to access, but it requires a completed and signed royalty-free licensing agreement and delivery by editorial email. The legal scope of the licence, territorial and term conditions, royalty waiver, ownership and authority to license, AI-assisted-music eligibility, exact genre fit, attachment size, number of tracks and international artist eligibility require human review. Final track selection, legal approval, agreement execution and sending must remain human-controlled.

dedupeTerms: Wepa.Fm Royalty-Free Independent Music Email Submission Route
deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Exact-name, domain, submission-path and mailbox searches in the accessible repository code-search surface returned no match before creation. The current branch contains a large unmerged historical dataset, so the canonical SQLite/domain/email dedupe must be rerun before any external outreach.
deduplication.consolidation: The independent-music page, public submission mailbox and signed-agreement requirement are stored as one canonical opportunity. The program/music director, marketing, event, booking and social contacts are excluded.

notes: One Wepa.Fm opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No agreement was downloaded or signed, and no email, attachment, music link, account, login, CAPTCHA, payment or submission action was completed.
